entities.name: Andreas Laun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andreas Laun was an Austrian Roman Catholic prelate. He was auxiliary Bishop of Salzburg from 1995 to 2017 and titular bishop of Libertina from 1995 until his death on 31 December 2024, at the age of 82.
